cohort: Five pregnant women with anakinra exposure from the Organization of Teratology Information Specialists Autoimmune Disease in Pregnancy Project in the USA and Canada
finding: Five pregnancies with anakinra exposure resulted in full-term singleton live births with no major or long-term complications, but two subjects developed oligohydramnios.
mod_finding: Two women had Cesarean sections, one medically indicated and one scheduled.
birth_weight: One infant had low birth weight
